proof:
Source: step 7 of the supplied proof of cbr_cipi_plane_halfspace_stokes. The use there of part (b) at the level T is supplied here by the hypothesis (HS).

Notation:
- ω := φ.
- V₀ := span(range v).
- H_t := {y : ⟨y, v_0⟩ < t}.
- L_t := {y : y − t v_0 ∈ span(range(Fin.tail v))}.

1. (A level beyond the support.) ω has compact support because φ is a test form, so K := tsupport ω is compact.
   - y ↦ ⟨y, v_0⟩ is continuous, so by IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn there is C ∈ ℝ with |⟨y, v_0⟩| ≤ C for all y ∈ K. (The norm on ℝ is the absolute value.)
   - Put T := C + 1.
   - Claim: if T ≤ ⟨y, v_0⟩ then y ∉ K. Indeed, y ∈ K would give ⟨y, v_0⟩ ≤ |⟨y, v_0⟩| ≤ C < C + 1 = T.

2. (Cut V₀ at the level T.)
   - V₀ is a submodule of the finite-dimensional space ℝ^P, hence finite-dimensional and closed (Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional), hence measurable. Also V₀ ∩ H_T ⊆ V₀.
   - Let y ∈ V₀ \ (V₀ ∩ H_T). Then y ∈ V₀ and not ⟨y, v_0⟩ < T, so T ≤ ⟨y, v_0⟩. By step 1, y ∉ tsupport ω.
   - tsupport(dω) ⊆ tsupport ω (tsupport_exteriorDerivative_subset), so y ∉ tsupport(dω).
   - Hence dω(y) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport), and dω(y)(v) = 0.
   By setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero (deprecated alias setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero):
   ∫_{V₀} dω(y)(v) dH^{d+1}(y) = ∫_{V₀∩H_T} dω(y)(v) dH^{d+1}(y).

3. (Apply (HS) at t = T.) By (HS) with t := T, the right side of step 2 equals ∫_{L_T} ω(y)(Fin.tail v) dH^d(y).

4. (The boundary integrand vanishes on L_T.) Let y ∈ L_T, i.e. y − T v_0 ∈ span(range(Fin.tail v)).
   - By Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun there is c : Fin d → ℝ with Σ_k c_k (Fin.tail v)_k = y − T v_0, i.e. Σ_k c_k v_{k.succ} = y − T v_0.
   - Hence y = Σ_{i ∈ Fin (d+1)} (Fin.cons T c)_i v_i. To see this, expand by Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero and Fin.cons_succ: the sum is T v_0 + (y − T v_0) = y.
   - By orthonormality (Orthonormal.inner_left_fintype; conjugation is trivial on ℝ), ⟨y, v_0⟩ = (Fin.cons T c)_0 = T.
   - So T ≤ ⟨y, v_0⟩, and step 1 gives y ∉ tsupport ω. Hence ω(y) = 0 and ω(y)(Fin.tail v) = 0.
   Therefore ∫_{L_T} ω(y)(Fin.tail v) dH^d(y) = 0 (setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero).

5. (Conclusion.) Steps 2, 3 and 4 give ∫_{V₀} dω(y)(v) dH^{d+1}(y) = ∫_{V₀∩H_T} dω(y)(v) dH^{d+1}(y) = ∫_{L_T} ω(y)(Fin.tail v) dH^d(y) = 0. ∎
key_steps: tsupport φ is compact, so |⟨y, v_0⟩| ≤ C on it. With T := C + 1, ⟨y, v_0⟩ ≥ T implies y ∉ tsupport φ.
V₀ is closed, hence measurable, and dφ vanishes on V₀ \ (V₀ ∩ H_T) because tsupport dφ ⊆ tsupport φ. So ∫_{V₀} dφ(v) = ∫_{V₀∩H_T} dφ(v).
(HS) at t = T turns this into ∫_{L_T} φ(y)(Fin.tail v) dH^d.
For y ∈ L_T, y = Σ (Fin.cons T c)_i v_i, so ⟨y, v_0⟩ = T. Hence φ(y) = 0 and the L_T integral is 0.
